source.title: Insight of the Blue - original Pdpaul firsthand comment
source.author: Pdpaul

quote: I just DE'ed 10 green weapons with a vendor value of 778g and got 25 Chromatic dusts
notes: One unindexed firsthand Dragonflight-era observation (original Wowhead profession-trait comment), not a complete drop table. Player says Draconic Disenchantment specialization maxed; exact Enchanting skill, other specialization nodes, gear item IDs/levels/bonuses, item origin, source collection date, game build, per-operation outputs, material hit casts, zero bins and Resourcefulness context not stated. The 10 disenchants and 25 dust are explicitly observed aggregate numbers; do not infer 10 dust-positive casts, dust probability, single-cast yield range, number of Resonant Crystal outcomes or any gold EV. Source comment also makes approximate anecdotal claims about crystals that do not provide a denominator, deliberately not transcribed as measured rates. Output family identity 194123 independently checked against the item listing https://goldcap.gg/retail/us/items/194123.
